acceptance.output_evidence: RUN IN BOTH FORMS, because they are not the same instrument. (a) The criterion's literal form, recorded above, rc=0 at 07:30:01Z-07:30:46Z: 'ARD-VERIFY mismatches=0 first=[]' then 'ARD-COTTONWOOD-VERIFY days=3325 match=3325/3325 manifests=3325/3325'. (b) Step 7's form, which AMENDMENT 5 names ('--verify-served --manifest <the manifest>'), rc=0 at 07:20:07Z-07:20:52Z: 'ARD-COTTONWOOD-VERIFY days=3325 match=3325/3325 sidecar=match method_row=match manifests=3325/3325'. Both clear the criterion's bar. THE LITERAL FORM IS THE WEAKER OF THE TWO: without --manifest it omits 'sidecar=' and 'method_row=' altogether and covers only the days and their manifests, which is exactly why AMENDMENT 5 re-reads the invocation as step 7's. The conditions are graded on (b); (a) is recorded because the criterion's text at HEAD still carries it and an unrun criterion invocation is not something to paper over. In both runs the mismatch list is EMPTY, not merely zero-counted.

mutant.description: A mint has no code mutant; the mutant's JOB here is DISCRIMINATION -- a read whose value differs between landed and not-landed -- and SIX named controls carry it. (1) SERVED-OBJECT CENSUS INDEPENDENT OF THE TOOL: The applier's own last line is a producer self-report, which CLAUDE.md forbids trusting. So the three prefixes were counted straight off S3 with aws s3api list-objects-v2, auto-paginated (never --no-paginate, never --query length()), counted client-side by basename, with IsTruncated read on every response. (2) VERSIONS-CENSUS POSITIVE CONTROL: An empty listing cannot by itself tell an empty prefix from a failed read, so the pre-write versions census was run beside a positive control on the parent prefix. (3) MANIFEST SHA256 ACROSS THE STAMP: Step 3 requires the manifest's sha256 to be unchanged after --stamp-manifest, i.e. the stamp must not mutate the pinned manifest. Measured before and after in the same call. (4) CONDITION 2'S LIMIT AND ITS REAL CONTROL: The CTO half accepts a named limit on condition 2: --show-day-manifest reaches build_manifest through helpers that MIRROR apply_days and are not called by it, so it shows what the producer writes for that input but not that apply_days hands the producer that input. The half names condition 3 as the control that closes the gap, and this records whether it actually did. (5) BOND COUNT ON THE WRITING RUN: Condition 4 requires the bond count re-read first and a refusal on anything but 0. It was read at L3 as its own step, and the --apply run independently re-ran it as its first act, so the figure is attached to the run that wrote rather than only to an earlier read. (6) OPEN-DEPLOYS UNION: Condition 5 and CLAUDE.md NEVER-2: a shared-tree read of .open_deploys/ is not evidence during worker deploys, so every live worktree was read with git ls-tree (not ls -1, which hides .unindexed_red_state.json) and unioned with a per-tree denominator.
mutant.expected: (1) 6650 = 3325 data.parquet + 3325 manifest.json, 1 sidecar, 2 method-row objects, against 0/0/0 on the same call before the write. (2) a NONZERO control count beside the three target zeros. (3) d2d99d5c...ce47b36 both before and after the stamp. (4) manifests=3325/3325, the read-back of what apply_days actually wrote. (5) measured_rows_on_bond_days=0 on the writing run itself. (6) a union with per-tree denominators, and a verdict on whether any entry covers this act.
mutant.observed: (1) 6650 = 3325 data.parquet + 3325 manifest.json; 1; 2. IsTruncated=None on all three. Before the write the identical call read 0/0/0. The instrument therefore distinguishes landed from not-landed on this exact target, and the post-write count matches the apply's arithmetic to the object. (2) Control irpt/cottonwood/ = 862 versions, 1 delete marker. Targets = 0 versions, 0 delete markers each. The zeros are real absence. (3) d2d99d5c4a127635170f77516b52fdfc0c163e151e39649e35569a601ce47b36 before and after. Identical. (4) manifests=3325/3325. The pre-write show on 2026-06-22 read method_version 3, positions_x_as_traded_close, net_of_fees, as_traded, custodian_text=absent, and the row-3 method sentence; the post-write read-back confirms the same fields on all 3325 served manifests. The limit is therefore discharged by measurement, not by assumption. (5) Standalone: 'ARD-COTTONWOOD-BOND-CHECK days=3325 rows=1691729 measured_rows=107316 measured_rows_on_bond_days=0 fixed_income_cusips=778'. The apply log's first line is the same bond-check line with the same two figures. No refusal. (6) 33 of 33 trees readable, per-tree counts printed (17 to 29), 659 row-reads summed, 93 DISTINCT open-deploy paths in the union. Word-boundary census over the union: 0 entries match cottonwood, 0 match ard as a token, 0 match al2 -- no prior entry for this act to resume. A first substring grep matched freshguard on 'ard' and was corrected to a word-boundary read; the false positive is named because a substring hit would have implied a stranded entry that does not exist. ALL SIX PASS. The sharpest is (1): the identical call read 0 objects on all three prefixes at L1 and 6,653 after, so landed and not-landed are distinguishable on this exact target by this exact instrument, and the post-write figure is not the tool's own claim about itself.

determinism.method: --verify-served was run twice over the same served state in two invocation forms (step 7's with --manifest, and the criterion's literal with --out), 10 minutes apart. The bond check was run twice: once standalone at L3 and once by the --apply run as its own first act. The four pinned sha256 were measured before the act and the manifest's again after the stamp. The three-prefix object census was run once post-write and compared against the same call's pre-write reading at L1.
determinism.observed: Stable. Both verify runs: rc=0, 'ARD-VERIFY mismatches=0 first=[]', days=3325 match=3325/3325 manifests=3325/3325 -- identical on every field the two forms share; step 7's form adds sidecar=match and method_row=match, which the literal form does not emit at all (a known difference in coverage, not a difference in result). Both bond-check runs: measured_rows=107316 measured_rows_on_bond_days=0. Manifest sha256 identical before and after the stamp. The census arithmetic (6650+1+2=6653) matches the apply's (3325x2+1+2) exactly.

declared_exclusions.reason: genre=DEPLOY is admitted only for an order whose ISSUER marked it a deploy at the cut with <proof_genre>DEPLOY</proof_genre> on its own line (3.0.0_SA_CVO verdict 29306, condition 1). Measured: the order carries 0 occurrences of proof_genre. The marker is the ISSUER's to place. Note for accuracy: this order's BOUNDS Grant line does extend to 'this order's file' (its <paths> block does not list it, so the two differ), which is why the <status> flip below is in grant -- so the reason for not adding <proof_genre> is NOT that the file is off limits. It is that a seat marking its own order a deploy, in order to be graded on the deploy branch it then fills in itself, is self-dealing on the gate: the marker exists to record the ISSUER's classification at the cut, and a classification I award myself after the fact carries none of that evidence. Declared instead, with every field the branch would have required carried verbatim above and expanded in section 1 and section 6 of org/missions/D8/ADVI/ADVI_COTBKF/deliverables/0.7.0_AE_CloudOps~CB2/ard_cottonwood_mint_report.md. For the issuer: adding that marker to the order would let a future instance of this act grade on the deploy branch, which is the right shape for it.
